rationale: Pooled knockout screen of ~1,350 transcription factors and immune regulators in primary human CD4+ T cells (Freimer et al. 2022, Nat Genet; GEO also lists PMIDs 39395408 and 41237776, later papers that reuse the data). Columns are self-named. The paper's primary screen sorted CD25 (IL2RA) high and low cells in three donors; high and low sorts come from the same donor's edited pool, so donor is paired and enters the model (2 residual df). Positive regulators of IL2RA are depleted in CD25-high relative to CD25-low; negative regulators are enriched. IL2RA itself is the positive control. IL-2 and CTLA4 sorts exist for two donors only and are not analyzed.
